title: VIOLENT MONDAY MORNING PRAYERS TO COMMAND THE WEEK
text: Hallelujah. Glory to God. Glory to God. Just lift your hands right where you are. Don't wait for anybody. Don't wait for anybody. The presence of God is already here. I can feel the weight of his glory. Something is about to happen tonight. Something is about to shift. I want you to open your mouth and just begin to worship him. Begin to bless him. Begin to magnify his name. He is Yahweh. He is the God that answers by fire. He is the God that speaks and it comes to pass. He is the lion of the tribe of Judah. He is the bright and morning star. He is the alpha and the omega. Worship him. Worship him. Shalabakandashia roo. Oh, I feel the presence of God. I feel the presence of God. There is an unusual atmosphere in this place. There is a weight. There is a density. Something is about to break loose. Something is about to be released. I need you to understand that you did not stumble upon this message by accident. The Holy Spirit orchestrated your presence here tonight. He arranged the circumstances of your life to bring you to this very moment because what God is about to do cannot be postponed any longer. Somebody say, "I am ready." >> Say it like you mean it. Say, "I am ready for what God is about to do." Oh, worship him. Worship him. Let the sound of worship fill this atmosphere. Let the fragrance of your praise ascend before his throne. You are Yahweh. You are Yahweh. There is no one like you, Lord. There is no one beside you. You are the God who sits upon the circle of the earth. You are the God who measures the waters in the hollow of your hand. You are the God who weighs the mountains in scales and the heels in a balance. Who has directed your spirit. Who has been your counselor. You are Yahweh. You are the unchangeable changer. You are the same yesterday, today, and forever. Your throne is established from of old. You are from everlasting to everlasting. Worship him. Worship him. Holy Spirit, we welcome you. Holy Spirit, we honor you. Holy Spirit, have your way in this place. Let your fire fall. Let your glory descend. Let your power be made manifest. We are not here for entertainment. We are not here for information. We are here for transformation. We are here for encounter. We are here for visitation. Somebody lift your voice and say, "Holy Spirit, visit me tonight." Say it with everything in you. Say, "Holy Spirit, visit me tonight." Shakarandala roos in this atmosphere. I sense messengers of fire being released. There is a portal opening over your life right now. There is a door swinging open in the realm of the spirit. What has been locked is being unlocked. What has been sealed is being unsealed. What has been closed is being opened. Before I go any further, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this message. Send the link to someone right now. Send it to that family member. Send it to that friend. Send it to that colleague. Send it to that person you have been praying for because you might be the vessel God uses to change their life forever. You might be the instrument through which their deliverance comes. You might be the channel through which their breakthrough is released. Don't keep this to yourself. The anointing on this message is not just for you alone. It is meant to flow through you to others. Share it now. Share it while the anointing is fresh. Share it while the fire is burning because somebody needs to hear what God is about to say tonight. Are we together? >> Oh, worship him again. Just lift your hands and worship him. We exalt you, Lord. We magnify your name. We lift you higher than the heavens. We lift you higher than every name that is named. You are above principalities. You are above powers. You are above might. You are above dominion. Every knee must bow at the mention of your name. Every tongue must confess that you are Lord. We worship you. We adore you. We bless you. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. [music] Glory to God. The title of this ministration as the spirit of God has breathed upon me is simply this. One prayer that changes everything. [music] Let me say it again. One prayer that changes everything. Listen to me very carefully. There are prayers and then there are prayers. Not all prayers carry the same weight. Not all prayers produce the [music] same results. Not all prayers unlock the same dimensions. There are prayers that you pray and nothing happens. And then there are prayers that you pray and everything changes. There are prayers that echo in the corridors of heaven and angels stand at attention. There are prayers that shake the foundations of darkness. There are prayers that rewrite the script of your destiny. There are prayers that reverse decades of stagnation in a single moment. Tonight you are going to pray that kind of prayer. I said tonight you are going to pray that kind of prayer. Turn to your neighbor and say neighbor tonight everything changes. Oh my God I feel the weight of this word. I feel the gravity of this moment. Some of you have been praying for years. Some of you have been fasting for seasons. Some of you have been crying out to God for what seems like an eternity. And you have wondered, "Does God hear me? Does my prayer make any difference? Is anything happening in the realm of the spirit? Let me tell you something tonight. God has had every prayer you have ever prayed. Not a single tear has fallen from your eyes that he has not collected. Not a single groan has escaped your lips that he has not recorded. Your prayers have been accumulating in heaven. They have been gathering momentum. They have been building [music and singing] pressure. And tonight the dam breaks. Tonight the floodgates open. Tonight the breakthrough comes. Somebody shout, "Tonight." Tonight. >> I want to take you to a powerful passage of scripture. Turn with me to First Kings chapter 18. First Kings 18 beginning from verse 36. The Bible says, "And I am reading from the King James version. And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice that Elijah the prophet came near and said, Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word. Verse 37. Hear me, oh Lord. Hear me that these people may know that thou art the Lord God and that thou has turned their heart back again. Verse 38, then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice and the wood and the stones and the dust and [music] licked up the water that was in the trench. Did you see that? One prayer, just one prayer and fire fell from heaven. One prayer and the sacrifice was consumed. One prayer and the water was licked up. One prayer and the stones were burned. One prayer and the nation was transformed. One prayer and the prophets of Bal were exposed. One prayer and the heavens were opened. That is the kind of prayer I am talking about tonight. The kind of prayer that changes everything. Look at your neighbor and tell them, "I am about to pray that prayer." You see, Elijah was surrounded by 450 prophets of Bal. He was outnumbered. He was surrounded by enemies. The whole nation had turned away from God. Jezebel was on the throne. Ahab was in the palace. Everything was against him. But Elijah knew something that many believers do not know. He knew that one prayer PRAYED IN FAITH BACKED by the power of God was enough to change everything. Write this down if you are taking notes. One prayer prayed in alignment with heaven carries more power than a thousand prayers prayed out of alignment. Let me say that again. One prayer prayed in alignment with heaven carries more power than a thousand prayers prayed out of alignment. Oh my God, I feel the weight of this word. I feel the gravity of this moment. Some of you have been praying for years. Some of you have been fasting for seasons. Some of you have been crying out to God for what seems like an eternity. And you have wondered, does God hear me? Does my prayer make any difference? Is anything happening in the realm of the spirit? Let me tell you something tonight. God has heard every prayer you have ever prayed. Not a single tear has fallen from your eyes that he has not collected. Not a single groan has escaped your lips that he has not recorded. Your prayers have been accumulating in heaven. They have been gathering momentum. They have been building [music] pressure. And tonight the dam breaks. Tonight the [music] floodgates open. Tonight the breakthrough comes. Somebody shout tonight. Tonight. >> I want to take you to a powerful passage of scripture. Turn with me to First Kings chapter 18. First Kings chapter 18 beginning from verse 36. The Bible says, "And I am reading from the King James version. And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice that Elijah the prophet came near and said, Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word. Verse 37. Hear me, oh Lord. HEAR ME THAT this people may know that thou art the Lord God and that thou has turned their heart back again. [music] Verse 38, then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burn sacrifice and the wood and the stones and the dust and licked up the water that was in the trench. [music] Did you see that? One prayer, just one prayer and fire fell from heaven. One prayer and the sacrifice was consumed. One prayer and the water was licked up. One prayer and the stones were burned. One prayer and the nation was transformed. One prayer and the prophets of Bal were exposed. One prayer and the heavens were opened. >> [music] >> That is the kind of prayer I am talking about tonight. The kind of prayer that changes everything. Listen to me carefully. Your prayer life needs energy. [music] Your prayer life needs fire. Your prayer life needs passion. You cannot approach the throne of grace with a cold heart and expect hot results. You cannot come before the King of Kings with lukewarm devotion and expect burning answers. Heaven responds to intensity. Heaven responds to desperation. Heaven responds to hunger. I decree and declare over your life tonight, the fire of God falls upon your prayer altar. The passion of the Holy Spirit is rekindled in your spirit. The zeal of the Lord consumes you. You will not be a casual prayer. You will not be a religious prayer. You will be a favvent prayer. You will be an effective prayer. You will be a powerful prayer. Somebody say amen. >> Amen. Now listen to me. I want to show you the characteristics of the one prayer that changes everything. Stay with me. Don't let your mind wander. Don't let your attention drift. This is critical. This is essential. This could be the missing piece you have been looking for. The first characteristic of the one prayer that changes everything is this. It is a prayer that is rooted in the word of God. Go back to first kings chapter 18. Look at what Elijah said. He said, "Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word." Did you see that? At thy word. Elijah's prayer was not based on his feelings. It was not based on his circumstances. It was not based on what he could see or hear or touch. It was based on the word of God. [music] He was reminding God of his own word. He was standing on the promises of scripture. He was building his case on divine revelation. This is the secret that many believers miss. When you pray, you must pray the word. You must speak the word. You must remind God of his own promises. Not because God forgets, but because when you pray the word, you are aligning yourself with heaven. You are synchronizing your faith with divine intention. You are creating a legal basis for God to move on your behalf. Turn to Isaiah 43 26. The Bible says, "Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. declare thou that thou mayest be justified. God himself says, "Put me in remembrance." He invites us to remind him of his word. He invites us to plead his promises. He invites us to declare his truth, not because he's forgetful, but because this is the protocol of the kingdom. This is how heaven operates. This is how prayers get answered. So when you pray tonight, don't just pray from your emotions. Don't just pray from YOUR FRUSTRATIONS. DON'T JUST PRAY from your desperation. Pray from the word. Anchor your prayers in scripture. LET EVERY PETITION BE BACKED BY A PROMISE. Let every request be supported by revelation. If you are praying for healing, find the scripture that says, "By his stripes we are healed from Isaiah 53:5." Stand on it. Declare it. Remind God of it. If you are praying for provision, find the scripture that says, "My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." From Philippians 4:E 19. Anchor your prayer in that promise. If you are praying for protection, find the scripture that says, "No weapon formed against thee shall prosper from Isaiah chapter 54 verse 17." Make that the foundation of your intercession. Are you following me? Is this making sense? Because this is going to transform your prayer life. I decree over your life tonight, the revelation of wordbased prayer enters your spirit. You will never pray empty prayers again. YOU WILL NEVER PRAY POWERLESS prayers again. Every prayer you pray from tonight will be saturated in scripture. Every petition you present will be anchored in revelation and heaven will respond. Somebody shout, "Heaven will respond." Heaven will respond. >> Oh, worship him for a moment. Just worship him. You are the God who honors your word. You are the God who watches over your word to perform it. Your word does not return void. Your word accomplishes the purpose for which it is sent. We worship you for your word. We praise you for your promises. We magnify you for your faithfulness. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Let me show you the second characteristic of the one prayer that changes everything. Not only must it be rooted in the word, but it must be offered in faith. Turn with me to Hebrews chapter 11 verse 6. This is a familiar scripture, but tonight I want you to see it with fresh eyes. The Bible says, "But without faith it is impossible to please him. For he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him. Did you see that? Without faith, it is impossible to please God. Not difficult, impossible. [music] Your prayers, no matter how eloquent, no matter how long, no matter how sincere, if they are offered without faith, they do not move God. Hallelujah. Glory to God. >> Glory to God. >> Oh, I feel a prophetic wind blowing in this [music] atmosphere. I feel the spirit of revelation being released. There are words of knowledge coming to me right now. There are prophetic utterances rising up in my spirit. Someone under the sound of [music] my voice. Your name is connected to grace. It might be grace itself or it might be a name that means grace in another language. The Lord is saying to you tonight, the grace you carry [music] is about to multiply. The favor on your life is about to increase. What you have been doing with minimal resources, you are about to do with abundant supply. Doors that required you to knock are about to swing open without effort. Opportunities that seem distant [music] are about to pursue you. The grace of God is being amplified over your life. There is a man here. Your name sounds like David or a variation of it. You have been battling with giants in your life. Goliaths that have taunted you, challenges that have mocked you, obstacles that have seemed insurmountable, but the spirit of God is saying to you tonight, the same anointing that was upon David is upon you. The stone is being released from the sling. The giant is going down. What has opposed you for years is being defeated tonight. I see a woman. You have been weeping in the night. Your pillow has been wet with tears. You have carried a burden that no one knows about. You have smiled in public but cried in private. But the Lord is saying to you tonight, weeping may endure for a night, but [music] joy comes in the morning. From Psalm 30:5, your morning has arrived. Your joy is being released. The tears are being turned into testimonies. The sorrow is being exchanged for celebration. Receive those words. Let them sink into your spirit. Let them anchor in your heart because they are not just words. They are prophetic declarations carrying creative power. Now let me continue with the teaching because I am not done. There is more revelation that must be released. We have seen that the one prayer that changes everything must be rooted in the word offered in faith prayed with persistence and come from a place of righteousness. Now let me show you the fifth characteristic. It must be specific. Turn with me to Mark 10 46-52. This is the story of blind Batimus. He was sitting by the highway begging when Jesus passed by and he began to cry out, "Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me." And people told him to be quiet, but he cried even louder. And Jesus stood still and commanded him to be called. Now look at verse 51. Jesus said to him, "What wilt thou that I should do unto thee?" Let that sink in. Jesus asked a blind man what he wanted. Was it not obvious? The man was blind. What else could he want? But Jesus asked him to be specific. And Batimos said, "Lord, that I might receive my sight." And immediately he received his sight. Here is the principle. God wants you to be specific in your prayers. He does not want you to pray vague, general, unfocused prayers. He wants you to identify exactly what you need. He wants you to articulate precisely what you are asking for. He wants you to define clearly what breakthrough looks like for you. [music] Many believers pray prayers like God bless me. But what does that mean? What does blessing look like for you? Is it a job? Is it a spouse? Is it healing? Is it a child? Is it financial breakthrough? Is it a house? Is it a promotion? Be specific. When you are specific in your prayers, you give heaven a target. [music] You create a bullseye for divine intervention. You make it clear what you are believing for. And when the answer comes, you will know it. You will recognize it. You will not wonder whether God has moved. I want you to take a moment right now and identify what you need God to do. Not 20 things, not 50 things, one thing. What is the one thing that if God did it tonight, everything in your life would change? What is the one prayer that if answered would transform your situation completely? Identify it. Name it. Be specific about it. Are you ready? Are you clear on what you need? Because we are about to enter the prayer dimension. We are about to shift from teaching into [music] intercession. We are about to move from revelation into manifestation. But before we do, let me give you one more characteristic of the one prayer that changes everything. And this might be the most important one. It [music] must be prayed in the name of Jesus. Turn to John chapter 14 13 and 14. Jesus said, "And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son. If ye shall ask anything in my name, I will do it." Did you see that? In my name, that phrase appears over and over in scripture. In my name, demons are cast out in his name. Diseases are healed in his name. Miracles are performed in his name. Prayers are answered in his name. The name of Jesus is not just a tag we add to the end of our prayers. It is not just a religious formality. It is not just tradition. The name of Jesus carries authority. The name of Jesus carries power. The name of Jesus carries legal backing in the courts of heaven. When you pray in the name of Jesus, you are not coming to God on your own merit. You are coming on the merit of Christ. You are not approaching the throne based on your righteousness. You are approaching based on his righteousness. You are not making requests based on what you deserve. You are making requests based on what he deserves. And because Jesus is worthy, your prayers are heard. Because Jesus is righteous. Your requests are granted. Because Jesus has favor with the Father, you have access. Oh, I feel the power of that name. I feel the authority of that name. There is no name higher. There is no name greater. There is no name more powerful. At the name of Jesus, every knee must bow in heaven, on earth, and under the earth. [music] At the name of Jesus, every tongue must confess that he is Lord. [music] At the name of Jesus, sickness fleas. At the name of Jesus, demons tremble at the name of Jesus. Mountains move [music] at the name of Jesus. Seas part at the name of Jesus. Dead things come to life. Somebody shout Jesus. >> Shout it again. Jesus. Let the name fill this atmosphere. Let the name saturate this moment. Jesus. Jesus. Jesus. [music] Shandela shako. Oh, the presence is here. The power is here. The glory is here. This is the moment. This is the hour. This is the time. Everything you have been waiting for is about to be released. Everything you have been believing for is about to manifest. Everything you have been praying for is about to come to pass. Now, I want you to stand to your feet. If you are able, stand to your feet. If you are driving, keep your eyes open, but engage your spirit. If you are lying down, sit up and be alert because what is about to happen requires your participation. It requires your engagement. It requires your faith. We're about to pray the one prayer that changes everything. But before I lead you, I want to explain what we are doing. We are not just praying words. We are releasing faith. We are not just speaking into the air. We are addressing the throne. We are not just hoping something happens. We are expecting breakthrough. Every prayer we pray tonight will be rooted in the word of God. Every declaration we make will be backed by scripture. Every petition we present will be saturated in faith. We will be specific. We will be persistent. We will pray in righteousness. And we will invoke the name that is above every name. Are you ready? Say, I am ready. I need you to say it like you mean it. Say, "I am ready." Lift your hands toward heaven. Open your mouth and let the spirit of God guide your utterance. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before your throne. Not with our own righteousness, but clothed in the righteousness of Christ. Not with our own merit, but standing on the merit of your son. Not with our own wisdom, but led by your spirit. We come boldly as your word commands in Hebrews 4:16 to obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. Tonight, Lord, we pray the one prayer that changes everything. We pray with faith. We pray with the word. We pray with persistence. We pray with specificity. We pray in the name of Jesus. Now I want you to open your mouth and begin to pray. Pray specifically for that one thing, that one breakthrough, that one miracle, that one answer. Let your voice rise. Let your faith soar. Let your spirit engage. Pray now. Pray now. Pray now. Lift your hands toward heaven. I decree and declare over your life tonight, the siege is over. Whatever has been besieging you has come to an end. The enemy that has surrounded you is retreating. The walls that have hemmed you in are falling. You are free. You are released. You are delivered. I decree [singing] and declare favor is your portion this week. Everywhere you go, favor follows you. Everyone you meet, favor greets you. Every door you knock on opens. Every opportunity you pursue succeeds. Favor, favor, favor. I decree and declare the answer to that one prayer is manifesting. What you have been believing for is coming to pass. What you have been waiting for is arriving. What you have been hoping for is materializing. The answer is here. I decree and declare your family is blessed. Your household is protected. Your marriage is strengthened. Your children are covered. Peace is in your home. Joy is in your dwelling. Love is in your relationships. [music] Hallelujah. Shakarandeote. [music] We give you glory Lord. We give you honor. We give you praise [music] forever and ever. Amen. And amen.
